question: how many customers do we have
how many orders were delivered
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered'

question: what's the total revenue from delivered orders
gold_sql: SELECT sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered'

question: who are our top five customers by revenue from delivered orders
gold_sql: SELECT c.full_name, sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.id, c.full_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: how many orders did acme corp place
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.company = 'Acme Corporation'

question: how many customers work at globe x
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customers WHERE company = 'Globex Inc'

question: how many echo buds pro units have we sold in total
gold_sql: SELECT sum(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.name = 'EchoBuds Pro'

question: list the names of customers in bangalore
gold_sql: SELECT full_name FROM customers WHERE city = 'Bengaluru'

question: show monthly order counts for twenty twenty five
gold_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date) AS month, count(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: how many orders came through the mobile app in q four twenty twenty four
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE channel = 'mobile' AND order_date >= '2024-10-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01'

question: what percentage of all orders were cancelled
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'cancelled') / count(*) FROM orders

question: which product category sold the most units last year
gold_sql: SELECT cat.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id WHERE extract(year FROM o.order_date) = extract(year FROM current_date) - 1 GROUP BY cat.name ORDER BY sum(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: what's our most expensive product
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY unit_price DESC LIMIT 1

question: how many products are in the gaming category
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Gaming'

question: which country brought in the most revenue from delivered orders
gold_sql: SELECT c.country FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) DESC LIMIT 1

question: how many new customers signed up each year
gold_sql: SELECT extract(year FROM signup_date) AS year, count(*) AS signups FROM customers GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: what's the average order value of delivered orders from enterprise customers
gold_sql: SELECT avg(order_total) FROM (SELECT o.id, sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS order_total FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE c.segment = 'enterprise' AND o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY o.id) t

question: break down returned orders by sales channel
gold_sql: SELECT channel, count(*) AS returned FROM orders WHERE status = 'returned' GROUP BY channel
